summary: One chaining Line tool replaces Polyline in sketches with connected edges. Clicks chain connected lines, and the two segments that meet at a point share it; 3-point Arc in the drawing bar adds arcs to the chain. A click on the chain's start closes it. A double-click on the last point, Enter, the Finish button or the first Escape saves the completed segments open, without a zero-length segment, and Line stays active for the next chain. A press, drag and release with nothing pending saves one line at once; during a chain a drag adds a segment, as in 0.0.772. With only a start placed, Escape discards it, and an Escape with nothing pending returns to Select. Arc, Rectangle, Circle and Slot follow the same rule wherever focus is: the first Escape discards their pending points and keeps the tool. While a chain with a completed segment is pending, the toolbar stays in view: choosing another tool, its letter shortcut or Finish sketch saves the chain open first, and a rejected save keeps Line and the chain for correction. An Escape during a chain's save leaves the tool once the save is accepted and never aborts it. P selects Line, whose shortcut reads L or P. The chain keeps Undo last and Backspace, Close profile and Close with line, Cancel drawing as the explicit discard, the Line and 3-point Arc segment modes, arrow keys, Space and Enter, the horizontal and vertical relations of 0.0.775, which the closing line never gets, and the attachments of Create relations, including the snap chooser and construction mode. A chain is one edit and one undo step, prepared once when it is saved; nothing is solved while it is pending, and hovering over a long pending chain renders no graph rows and none of its drawn segments. Older profile sketches that keep closed profiles only, and Curves, keep their earlier rules: a profile sketch closes with Close profile, Enter or a click on its start, a Curve finishes with Finish curve, and Escape discards either drawing. The path tool id and the polyline drawing kind remain aliases.
warning: Potentially breaking for people and automation that drive the sketch canvas: two clicks with Line no longer save a line. The chain continues until it is finished with a double-click, Enter, Finish or Escape, or closed on its start. Escape now saves the completed segments of a pending chain, where Polyline discarded them, and an Escape with nothing pending returns to Select. With focus outside the canvas, the first Escape discards a pending Arc, Rectangle, Circle or Slot and keeps the tool, where it also returned to Select before. The Polyline button is removed and P selects Line. Accessible names change: Finish polyline is now Finish chain, and the snap hints Close polyline and Polyline start are now Close chain and Chain start. The Finish button shows Finish. The canvas instructions, the keyboard help and the drawing error messages say chain or Line instead of polyline or Polyline. WebMCP tools, their arguments and results, the CAD schema and saved documents are unchanged. No breaking change for installed posts, machine packages, saved revisions or controller output.

checklist.schema: No CAD schema change: a chain saves through the existing append-sketch-entities edit with the existing line, arc, coincident, point-on-line, point-on-curve, fixed-axis, horizontal and vertical kinds. No UPID, post, machine package, execution plan, saved revision, storage, journal, worker reply or native buffer protocol change; the Rust solver and committed WebAssembly module are unchanged. Post engine API remains 1 and saved-job engine remains 3.
checklist.events: No execution event or input-version behavior change. A pending chain is a pending workflow, as a Polyline was, so agent mutations return WORKFLOW_OPEN until it is finished or cancelled. A chain saved by a tool switch, Finish sketch or Escape uses the same cancellable, source- and version-checked submission as Enter. The next step runs only after acceptance, a rejection keeps the draft, and an Escape during the save never aborts it. WebMCP tools and their arguments are unchanged.
checklist.capabilities: No post or machine capability change. Line replaces Polyline in sketches with connected edges; Curves and profile-only sketches keep their rules.
checklist.auditAndOutput: No generation, audit, numbering, encoding, line ending, feed or controller-file change.
checklist.installationAndStorage: No installed package, revision, browser-cache or folder storage change. Saved documents open unchanged, and the drawing tool is not persisted.
checklist.verification: cadPathDrawing.test.ts checks that each chain segment continues from the previous end, that only a return to the start bounding an area closes it, that an open finish keeps the completed segments and drops a pending arc end, and undo and mode switches between segments. cadPathDraftGraph.test.ts checks that the segments meeting at a chain point share it. CadSketchPathDrawing.test.tsx checks that a double-click, Enter, Finish and Escape save the same chain and keep the tool, that a drag from idle saves one line while a tap and a drag from the tapped point continue a chain, that a lone start is discarded and a further Escape is left unhandled, that Arc, Rectangle, Circle and Slot discard on Escape, that a rejected save keeps the chain and the tool, that an Escape during a save leaves the tool only after acceptance without aborting it, and that a profile-only sketch and a new Curve keep their explicit finish through a drag and a double-click. CadSketchCanvasPicking.test.tsx checks that a line dragged from idle onto an ambiguous end saves once its end is chosen, and keeps its guide, attachment, snap chooser and wobble cases with each chain finished explicitly. CadSketchCanvasRender.test.tsx checks that hovering over a pending chain of 31 lines and an arc renders no graph rows, draws no segment again and saves nothing. CadWorkbench.test.tsx checks that Escape from the canvas or anywhere saves a chain with shared joints as one undo step and a second Escape returns to Select, a lone start, Arc, Rectangle, Circle and Slot from anywhere, that Enter, Finish and a double-click build the same graph, horizontal and vertical guides on chain lines but none on the closing line, and that a tool switch, its shortcut and Finish sketch save the chain first while a rejected save keeps Line and the chain. CadCurveWorkbench.test.tsx checks that a Curve keeps Finish curve, offers no open finish and discards on Escape. Each of these regression tests failed with its fix reverted. The full Vitest suite (555 files, 6327 tests), lint, ui:check, build and the release check pass. In Chromium, run one spec at a time, the new cad-sketch-line-chain test chains clicked lines to a double-click, saves a dragged line, saves on Escape and returns to Select on the next, discards a lone start, saves before a switch to Arc and undoes a chain in one step; cad-sketch-constraints, cad-sketch-editing, cad-sketch-offset and cad-workflow pass. Hover P50 at 4x CPU in a production Chromium build, 60 rectangles and a pending 50-segment chain, after a warm-up run, two rounds of three runs: Line 36.7 to 44.9 ms against 36.9 to 48.7 ms for Polyline on 0.0.779, P95 69.2 to 79.1 ms against 61.8 to 79.8 ms, the same within noise. Both are above the earlier 26 ms baseline, which had no pending chain; a pending 50-segment Polyline costs the same on 0.0.779, so Line adds nothing to it.

publicNotes.summary: Line draws connected chains and replaces Polyline.
changes: Line chains connected lines and arcs that share each joint. Click each point, then double-click, press Enter, choose Finish or press Escape to save the chain, or click its start to close it.
Press, drag and release with nothing pending to draw and save one line.

Escape saves a pending chain. With only a start placed it discards it, and with nothing pending it returns to Select. Arc, Rectangle, Circle and Slot discard their pending points on the first Escape and keep the tool.
Choosing another tool or Finish sketch saves a pending chain first. P selects Line.
publicNotes.compatibility: No file, schema or tool change. Older profile sketches and Curves keep their drawing rules. Installed machine packages, posts, saved revisions and controller output are unchanged.
publicNotes.action: Finish a line chain with a double-click, Enter, Finish or Escape: two clicks no longer save a line on their own. Automation that clicks Polyline or Finish polyline should use Line and Finish chain.
